name: South Dakota

agency.name: South Dakota Department of Agriculture and Natural Resources (DANR)

overview: South Dakota DANR's Air Quality Program issues minor source operating permits (ARSD 74:36:04), Title V (Part 70) operating permits, general permits for portable and stationary sources (asphalt plants, rock crushers, concrete plants, grain elevators), and PSD pre-construction permits (ARSD 74:36:09, adopting 40 CFR 52.21). South Dakota is in attainment, so nonattainment NSR (ARSD 74:36:10) does not currently apply. The Rapid City area has PM10 Natural Events Action Plan requirements, including general permits for construction and continuous activities on state property. EPA Region 8 is the permitting authority in Indian Country.

permitTypes.name: Insignificant activities
permitTypes.description: DANR provides an Insignificant Activities data sheet to be submitted with applications. DANR's permitting page does not list facility-level exemptions.

permitTypes.name: General Permits
permitTypes.description: For portable or stationary Part 70, synthetic minor, or minor sources: asphalt plants, rock crushers, concrete batch plants, grain elevators, and (Rapid City area) construction and continuous activities on state property. Requires an application and a Notice of Intent to operate. Flat annual fees apply to asphalt plant and rock crusher general permits.

permitTypes.name: Construction Permit
permitTypes.description: DANR provides a general construction permit application form. DANR's permitting page describes pre-construction permits mainly in the PSD context.

permitTypes.name: Minor Source Operating Permit
permitTypes.description: For sources that are not Part 70 sources and are below the uncontrolled potential emission level for Part 70.
permitTypes.thresholds: Uncontrolled potential emissions below 100 tons per year of a regulated pollutant (restated from DANR).

permitTypes.name: Prevention of Significant Deterioration (PSD) pre-construction permit
permitTypes.description: New or modified sources in attainment areas meeting PSD applicability must obtain a pre-construction permit. Adopts 40 CFR 52.21 by reference.

permitTypes.name: New Source Review (nonattainment)
permitTypes.description: Applies only in areas designated nonattainment; DANR states South Dakota is in attainment, so it does not currently apply.

permitTypes.name: Title V (Part 70) Operating Permit
permitTypes.description: For major sources, and sources that fall under NSPS or MACT applicability requirements. Fees under ARSD 74:37 (administrative fee by emission tier plus a per-ton emission fee).
permitTypes.thresholds: Potential to emit greater than 100 tons per year of a regulated pollutant, more than 10 tons per year of one HAP, or more than 25 tons per year of combined HAPs (DANR quotes 'greater than 100 tons per year').

oilAndGas.summary: DANR's air permitting and application pages list no oil and gas specific air permits. Oil and gas sources follow the minor source and Title V thresholds and applicable federal NSPS/NESHAP (adopted by reference in ARSD 74:36:07 and 74:36:08). Oil and gas wells on tribal lands fall under EPA Region 8.

notes: ARSD 74:36:05 as the Part 70 chapter is from general knowledge; DANR's page did not cite it and the SD Legislature rules site requires JavaScript. 74:36:04, :09, and :10 are confirmed in DANR's concrete GP statement of basis. Fees (as listed by DANR): administrative fee $1,383 / $666 / $138 by emission tier plus $8.30 per ton; check ARSD 74:37 for current amounts. No online permit application; fees can be paid online.
